# A book kept in Hong Kong dollars that buys US dollars, buys US-listed shares
# with them, and spends some of the dollars without saying which cost basis
# they came out of.
#
# Cost bases are recorded in Canadian dollars, whatever currency a book is kept
# in: `services/foreign_currency.py` reads every cost in `BASE_CURRENCY`. This
# book states no Canadian figure anywhere, so it opens no cost basis at all, and
# none of what depends on one applies: nothing asks the spend for a guid, the
# shares carry no cost, and the balance sheet leaves the realized keys off
# rather than stating a gain it did not measure.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_hkd_book_gets_no_cost_basis_while_costs_are_recorded_in_cad.py.

	fraction: 100
